summary: Verified the 3 new features (admin walk-around video + security deposit, customer share-location button, customer pre-assignment deposit card) and corresponding backend endpoints. Backend deposit endpoints (GET /deposits/me, POST /deposits, POST /deposits/{id}/mark-paid) all PASS (3/3 pytest). Customer Home location-banner renders and share-location-button correctly hidden on web. Admin Vehicle modal has both field-deposit and Walk-around Video record/gallery buttons. TWO CRITICAL BUGS BLOCKING FEATURE: (1) POST /api/vehicles drops security_deposit and walk_around_video fields server-side (Vehicle(...) constructor in server.py:397-402 silently ignores body.security_deposit + body.walk_around_video, so admin entered ₹2500 persists as default ₹2000). (2) customer/payments.tsx never renders the deposit card -- `showDepositCard`, `depositShortfall`, `startDeposit` and styles.depositCard* are all defined but no JSX block references them, so the deposit card is invisible regardless of state. End-to-end the customer can NEVER pay a security deposit from the Payments tab on either web or native.

critical.issue: Handler drops `security_deposit` and `walk_around_video` from the VehicleCreate body. server.py:395-404 builds Vehicle(...) without passing those two fields, so DB stores Vehicle defaults (security_deposit=2000.0, walk_around_video=None) regardless of what admin sends. Repro: POST {security_deposit:2500, walk_around_video:'data:video/mp4;base64,AAAA'} returns 200 with security_deposit=2000.0 and walk_around_video=null. Test: backend/tests/test_deposits_and_vehicles.py::TestVehicleCreate::test_create_vehicle_with_deposit_and_video FAILED.

ui_bugs.component: customer/payments.tsx — Deposit card missing from JSX
ui_bugs.issue: `showDepositCard`, `depositShortfall`, `startDeposit`, and styles.depositCard/depositLabel/depositAmount/depositMuted/depositSub/depositCta/depositCtaText are all defined (lines 64-89, 245-251) but the JSX render tree (lines 92-148) NEVER renders a <View style={styles.depositCard}>. As a result, customer cannot pay or view security deposit from the Payments tab. Verified live: approved customer with security_deposit=2000 vehicle assigned + ₹2000 already paid still sees only weekly rent ₹700; no deposit card, no `Pay Deposit` CTA, no testID for deposit-card. Add a JSX block like `{showDepositCard && (<View testID="deposit-card" style={styles.depositCard}>... <Pressable testID="pay-deposit-button" onPress={() => startDeposit(depositShortfall || requiredDeposit)}>Pay Deposit</Pressable></View>)}` between the pending-banner (line 108) and the FlatList (line 110).

integration_issues.flow: Admin creates vehicle with security_deposit=2500 → assigns to customer → customer tries to pay deposit
integration_issues.issue: Two cascading bugs prevent this flow: (a) backend silently drops security_deposit so vehicle is stored as 2000; (b) customer Payments screen never renders the deposit card. Even using the backend's actual stored deposit (2000), the customer UI offers no way to pay it.

issues: List rows show only `₹<rent>/wk` + status; security_deposit is invisible in the list, so admin has no visual confirmation that the deposit field was persisted. Combined with the backend bug this also masks the silent data loss.

action_items: [CRITICAL backend] In server.py:create_vehicle (line ~395), pass `security_deposit=body.security_deposit, walk_around_video=body.walk_around_video` into the Vehicle(...) constructor so admin-entered values persist.

[CRITICAL frontend] In customer/payments.tsx, render a deposit card block when `showDepositCard` is true. Wire it to `startDeposit(depositShortfall || requiredDeposit || deposit.balance)` and add testIDs `deposit-card` and `pay-deposit-button`. The `activeDeposit` modal + testID=`deposit-txn-input` / `confirm-deposit-button` already exist and work — only the entry-point card is missing.
[MEDIUM frontend] On admin/vehicles list rows, display security_deposit alongside weekly rent (e.g. `₹700/wk · Deposit ₹2500`) so admins can verify persistence at a glance.
[INFO] /api/healthz returns 404 — consider adding it for liveness; not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:395 create_vehicle silently drops two model fields — this is a model/route drift smell. The Vehicle constructor should be built with **body.dict() and only id/status/assigned_to/created_at injected; that way new fields added to VehicleCreate are auto-propagated.
PUT /vehicles/{vid} is correct (uses body.dict() with None filtered), so EDIT works fine — only CREATE is broken. This asymmetry makes the bug easy to miss during smoke testing.

customer/payments.tsx has ~7 unused style entries + 3 unused functions/vars (showDepositCard, depositShortfall, startDeposit). TypeScript/ESLint should ideally flag these as dead code; consider enabling `no-unused-vars` to catch similar misses in the future.

Multiple deprecated RN-Web warnings in console (`props.pointerEvents is deprecated`, `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"`). Source is third-party libraries; not blocking but worth tracking for future RN upgrade.

success_rate.backend: 60% (3/5 — deposits CRUD passes; vehicle create with new fields + assignment gate fail because of the create bug)
success_rate.frontend: 66% (admin walk-around+deposit fields rendered correctly; customer home location-banner correct; customer payments deposit card completely missing)

seed_data_creation: Created admin-side vehicles 'TEST DepoBike' (security_deposit fell back to 2000 due to bug) and 'TEST UI Bike' via admin UI. Created test customers with phones 8888821047 and 8888822112 (approved). Customer 8888822112 has a paid ₹2500 deposit. Safe to leave; all are TEST-prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes (1) server.py:create_vehicle to forward security_deposit+walk_around_video, and (2) renders a deposit card in customer/payments.tsx with testID=deposit-card and a pay-deposit-button: re-run /app/backend/tests/test_deposits_and_vehicles.py (must hit 5/5), then UI-verify customer flow: login as 8888822112 (already approved, deposit paid) → Payments → confirm deposit card shows balance ₹2500 (or required deposit). For a from-scratch flow, create a new vehicle with deposit=2500, assign it to a fresh customer (expect 412), then customer pays deposit via the new card, then assign succeeds. Existing TestVehicleCreate.test_create_vehicle_with_deposit_and_video and TestAssignmentDepositGate.test_assign_after_deposit_succeeds will pass once backend is fixed.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (backend): server.py create_vehicle builds Vehicle(...) with an explicit positional/keyword list that omits security_deposit and walk_around_video. Pydantic happily fills in defaults (2000.0 / None) so no validation error is raised — data loss is silent. Fix: change to `v = Vehicle(id=str(uuid.uuid4()), status='available', created_at=now_utc_iso(), **body.dict())`. Bug 2 (frontend): customer/payments.tsx was refactored to add deposit-related state/handlers + styles, but the corresponding JSX `<View testID="deposit-card">...` block was never added between the pending-banner and the FlatList. Confirmed by grepping the file: `showDepositCard` is referenced only on the definition line; no consumer JSX uses it. Mitigation: insert the missing JSX (see action_items).
